directives.treatmentMonitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — modernization program milestones using acquisition milestone tracking. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — modernization program milestones measured quarterly. Target: 90% milestones on time. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against GAO Selected Acquisition benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — modernization program milestones trending toward 95% on time. Escalate if <80% on time floor.
directives.treatmentEscalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a air operations and aerospace systems strategist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
